cases.expected: Returns an unmodifiable list containing the validators produced by read(schemaNode). The returned list cannot be modified (throws UnsupportedOperationException on add).
cases.description: First call to getValidators() on a newly created JsonSchema instance where the internal `validators` field is null. The method should invoke `read(getSchemaNode())`, wrap the result with `Collections.unmodifiableList`, assign it to the field, and return it.

group: getValidators - when validators is already initialized

cases.expected: Returns the previously stored unmodifiable list without invoking read(). The same list instance is returned on subsequent calls.
cases.description: Second (or later) call to getValidators() after the `validators` field has already been set. The method should bypass the `if` block and directly return the cached list, ensuring no additional call to `read()` occurs.

cases.expected: Returns an unmodifiable empty list when the internal `read` method yields an empty mutable list. The list size is 0 and attempts to add elements throw UnsupportedOperationException.
cases.description: A JsonSchema spy is configured so that `read(getSchemaNode())` returns `new ArrayList<>()`. The first call to `getValidators()` should store and return an unmodifiable view of this empty list. Verifies that the list is empty and immutable.

group: getValidators - when read throws runtime exception

cases.expected: IllegalStateException is propagated from the read() method
cases.description: A JsonSchema spy is configured so that the private read(JsonNode) method throws an IllegalStateException. The first call to getValidators() should propagate this exception without wrapping it.
